categories.main_business_segments: Henan Shuanghui Investment & Development Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the meat industry, covering the entire meat production chain including feed production, livestock breeding, slaughtering, meat processing, packaging, seasoning, and commercial sales. The company focuses on fresh pork products, packaged meat products, and fresh poultry products, with additional operations in import/export trade, seasoning production, packaging materials, and food additives. It also engages in related services such as technical consulting, warehousing, and catering management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including world-class pig slaughtering and cold-cutting production lines, cold chain logistics, and automated poultry processing lines. It uses cold cooling and acid removal, precise fresh meat preservation techniques, and intelligent manufacturing technologies for meat products. The company has implemented ISO9001, HACCP, ISO22000 quality management systems and digital traceability systems covering procurement to sales. R&D focuses on product innovation, smart processing, and preservation technologies tailored to Chinese culinary habits.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Shuanghui serves a broad customer base including retail supermarkets, convenience stores, restaurants, food processing factories, and wholesale markets. Its products cater to diverse consumer groups with a focus on household consumption and foodservice sectors. The company also targets emerging digital sales channels such as e-commerce platforms (Tmall, JD.com, Douyin) and new retail formats. Its major customers include numerous distributors and end consumers across China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with over 30 modern meat processing bases in 18 provinces including Henan, Heilongjiang, Hebei, Shandong, Anhui, Hubei, Jiangxi, Shanghai, Shaanxi, Sichuan, and Guangxi. It has a nationwide sales network with over one million retail outlets and distribution points. The company also engages in international trade and leverages global resources through its parent company Rotary Vortex Limited and Rise Grand Group Limited.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shuanghui operates across the entire meat supply chain, from upstream feed production and livestock breeding, through midstream slaughtering and meat processing, to downstream packaging, seasoning, distribution, and retail. It is a fully integrated meat industry cluster with strong upstream and downstream linkages, enabling significant synergy and control over product quality and supply stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include industrialization, diversification, internationalization, and digitalization. R&D focuses on product innovation to meet diversified, personalized, and quality-driven consumer demands, including development of Chinese-style fresh prepared foods, intelligent processing technologies, and preservation methods. It invests in automation, smart manufacturing, and digital traceability to enhance efficiency and product safety. The company also emphasizes brand rejuvenation and expansion into new sales channels.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of meat products including packaged meat, fresh pork, and poultry products. Sales occur via direct sales and distributor networks, both offline and online through e-commerce platforms. The company also earns income from related services such as seasoning production, packaging materials, and catering management. Investment income and government subsidies contribute marginally to overall revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shuanghui is a leading brand in China’s meat industry, recognized as the largest and one of the most influential meat service providers in the country. It holds a dominant market position with a brand value of approximately 87.2 billion RMB. The company benefits from scale, brand strength, technological leadership, and extensive distribution networks. It competes with other large meat processors and integrated agribusinesses in China, leveraging its comprehensive industrial chain and innovation capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately 59.56 billion RMB, a slight decrease of 0.55% year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about 4.99 billion RMB, down 1.26%. Total assets reached 37.29 billion RMB, with a modest growth of 1.66%. The company maintains strong cash flow generation, with operating cash flow increasing by 148.42% to over 8.4 billion RMB. Despite some revenue pressure, profitability remains stable, supported by operational efficiencies and product mix optimization.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shuanghui emphasizes product quality, safety, and innovation, offering a wide range of meat products tailored to Chinese consumer preferences. Its value proposition includes fresh, nutritious, and convenient meat products supported by advanced processing technologies and stringent quality control systems. The company’s strong brand recognition, extensive cold chain logistics, and diversified product portfolio differentiate it in the competitive meat market. It also focuses on digital transformation and marketing innovation to enhance consumer engagement and brand loyalty.
